AI summary: Jensen Huang's reinstatement as Nvidia CEO, which investors initially cheered, was followed on Tuesday by renewed unease in AI credit markets, with CoreWeave's stock falling 13% and its CDS spreads widening over 8.5%. For someone following NVDA, the key issue is that Huang is seen as central to Nvidia's financing of the AI buildout, including guarantees totaling $118 billion as of Oct. 25, and credit investors worry this "circular financing" could continue, while analysts remain divided on whether it will and state and federal investigations into Nvidia and Huang are ramping up.
